description: No mechanism exists for data subjects to obtain confirmation of whether their personal data is being processed and to access that data. The right of access is a fundamental data subject right.
applicability: Applicable to all data controllers. Must provide mechanism for data subjects to request and receive copies of their personal data and processing information.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data subject request handling capabilities. Verify ability to locate, compile, and provide all personal data for a given subject.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Data Subject Rights
